title: Architectural Levels Zoom
description: Interactive visualization demonstrating progressive zoom levels of clock system architecture, revealing components from high-level overview to detailed internal structure including microcontroller cores and PIO.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: System Architecture
Hardware Components
Clock Design
Microcontroller
Embedded Systems
learningObjectives: Sequence the ten zoom levels that progressively reveal the clock system's components, from a single Clock block to dual cores and PIO inside the microcontroller
Identify which components communicate over the SPI bus (display) versus the I2C bus (real-time clock)
Describe the role of each major subsystem revealed by the zoom slider: display, microcontroller, RTC, buttons, power system, and speaker
Analyze how hierarchical decomposition lets a complex embedded system be understood one abstraction level at a time
